question: How can I speak to Regional Council about the budget?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: You can register online to speak as a delegation to Regional Council [1]. Registering by noon one week before the meeting gives you five minutes to speak [2]. If you register after that deadline, you get three minutes to speak [3]. You must send any slides or handouts to the Clerk at least 24 hours before the meeting [4].

statements.text: You can register online to speak as a delegation to Regional Council.

citations.quote: To register as a delegation for any Committee or Council meeting, please visit https://forms.regionofwaterloo.ca/Council-and-Administrative- Services/CAS/Delegation-Registration.

statements.text: Registering by noon one week before the meeting gets you five minutes to speak.

citations.quote: If you register by noon one week before the meeting you will be listed on the agenda and be allowed to speak for 5 minutes.

statements.text: If you register after the deadline, you have three minutes to speak.

citations.quote: Delegations that register after the deadline may still be heard but will have 3 minutes to speak.

statements.text: Send any slides or handouts to the Clerk at least 24 hours before the meeting.

citations.quote: Any materials (including slide decks and handouts) that you wish to share at the meeting must be received by the Clerk’s Office at least 24 hours before the meeting.
